pyFBS.VPT¶

Short description

class pyFBS.VPT(ch, refch, vp_ch, vp_refch, Wu=None, Wf=None)[source]¶

Virtual point transformation - Description

Parameters

  • ch (pandas.DataFrame) – Channels used in the transformation (outputs - sensors).

  • refch (pandas.DataFrame) – Reference channels used in the transformation (input - impacts).

  • vp_ch (pandas.DataFrame) – Virtual point channels used in the transformation (output - VP).

  • vp_refch (pandas.DataFrame) – Virtual point reference channels used in the transformation (input - VP).

  • Wu (numpy.array) – Displacement weighting matrix.

  • Wf (numpy.array) – Displacement weighting matrix.

define_IDM_F()[source]¶

Calculates the Rf, Tf, Ff matrices based on the supplied position and orientation of Channels and Virtual Channels. In the current implementation only Rigid IDMs are supported.

define_IDM_U()[source]¶

Calculates the Ru, Tu, Fu matrices based on the supplied position and orientation of Channels and Virtual Channels. In the current implementation only Rigid IDMs are supported.
